spoken_summary: During a cabinet meeting, a reporter informs President Trump that "the biggest pop culture news of the year broke," announcing that Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift are engaged. She asks for his reaction. Trump replies, "Well, I wish them a lot of luck." He continues by saying he thinks Kelce is a "great player" and a "great guy," and that Swift is a "terrific person," reiterating his well wishes for them.
